freezeRule: The final v1.0.1 file is immutable from the moment its SHA-256 is written to the external registration artifact, before result generation. Any later change requires a new version with a POST_RESULT_ADJUSTMENT marker and invalidates confirmatory language for the affected question.

entryEvidence.p5AuxiliaryBridgeProvenance: V7 Job 2D, official CNCT course-to-CBO normative correspondence materialization; school-location EPT offer and workplace RAIS remain separate lenses

sharedRules.lensPolicy: resident_population_school_location_workplace_and_executor_lenses_remain_named; alignment is ecological and never becomes an individual linkage
sharedRules.scopePolicy: statewide inference requires coverage_scope RS_497; VALE_10 never represents RS
sharedRules.effectPrecedenceRule: No terminal state or claim above DISTRIBUTIONAL_PATTERN may be assigned from a p-value alone. Every positive inferential state must first meet its named substantiveEffectThreshold and interval-or-bound rule; p-value and BH criteria are secondary conjunctive gates.
sharedRules.randomGenerator: numpy.random.Generator with PCG64; per-fit seed is the unsigned first 64 bits of SHA-256('4313375|fit_id|procedure_id'); rows and municipality codes are sorted before draws
sharedRules.smallSampleMethodRationale: P4/P7 are longitudinal fixed-effects regressions with municipality-clustered dependence, so inference flips cluster residual signs. P6 is a ten-municipality cross-sectional correlation, so inference permutes outcome labels. Procedures are fixed by design class, never selected from results.

multipleTesting.scope: all non-null p-values, including predeclared alternatives and sensitivities, within each family
multipleTesting.nonInferentialRows: must carry pValueState NOT_APPLICABLE_PREDECLARED and a reason before results
multipleTesting.fixedFamilyDenominator: m is always the predeclared expectedPValueCount for the family (7, 6, 4, 6 or 4). An invalid fit occupies its fixed slot as p=1 only inside the BH calculation, while its serialized raw and adjusted p-values remain null with pValueState INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
multipleTesting.discretePValueHandling: resampling and continuous p-values use the same fixed-family BH procedure; ties are ordered by result_id for deterministic computation and monotone adjusted values; attainable raw p-value floor and grid are serialized for every resampling fit
multipleTesting.structurallyUnattainableRule: If attainable_raw_p_floor multiplied by fixed family m exceeds familyDecisionAlpha, no rejection state is possible and the affected question is PLANNING_SIGNAL_ONLY or NO_ROBUST_ASSOCIATION according to its ordered rule, with the fixed low-power caveat; alpha is never relaxed.
multipleTesting.crossFamilyControl: none; five substantively distinct families are not pooled
multipleTesting.mandatoryDisclosure: No cross-family error-rate control is applied; no integrated conclusion may rest on one adjusted p-value without effect-size and robustness support.

minimumCoverage.coverageDisclosure: Every fit and scope comparison reports eligible, retained and excluded municipality counts plus missingness reasons; RS_497 is a source-coverage label, never a claim of 497 complete cases.

coverageToClaimMap.497: RS_COMPLETE_CASES_497; declared question claim ceiling may be used
coverageToClaimMap.450_TO_496: RS_SOURCE_SCOPE_WITH_NONEXHAUSTIVE_ANALYTIC_SAMPLE; declared ceiling is retained only with a mandatory attrition caveat and no phrase implying all 497 municipalities

ValePanelCoverageToClaimMap.10: VALE_COMPLETE_CASES_10; declared question ceiling may be used
ValePanelCoverageToClaimMap.9: VALE_SOURCE_SCOPE_WITH_NONEXHAUSTIVE_ANALYTIC_SAMPLE; mandatory attrition caveat and no phrase implying all ten municipalities

ValeSnapshotCoverageToClaimMap.10: VALE_COMPLETE_CASES_10; declared question ceiling may be used
ValeSnapshotCoverageToClaimMap.8_TO_9: VALE_SOURCE_SCOPE_WITH_NONEXHAUSTIVE_ANALYTIC_SAMPLE; mandatory attrition caveat and no phrase implying all ten municipalities

minimumCoverage.NovaSantaRitaCoverageRule: MUNICIPALITY_4313375 is AVAILABLE only when every row required by the specific measure is present and valid. Otherwise its scope row is materialized UNAVAILABLE with reason; questions that explicitly require the case in validityCriteria become INSUFFICIENT_DATA, while regional results remain separately evaluable where allowed.
minimumCoverage.statewideFitInputRule: Every row entering an RS fit must have coverage_scope RS_497. A VALE_10 row can never enter an RS-scoped fit; Vale descriptors are computed separately from RS_497 source rows or explicitly unavailable.

panel: at least two observations per retained municipality
snapshot: at least four distinct ranks in each variable
modelValidity.unavailableSensitivityFallback: Every failed fit is materialized with null p-value and INSUFFICIENT_DATA reason. The question follows its ordered terminal rule: P3 and P8 require all named fits; P4 and P6 require their stated validity counts; P7 permits one component to remain valid. No denominator is silently reduced.

permissionsAndCeilings.P2: permitted only as a cross-lens accounting identity; maximum ACCOUNTING_DECOMPOSITION; never a rate, attendance or coverage measure
permissionsAndCeilings.P4: permitted only as an ecological territorial intensity; maximum PLANNING_SIGNAL; never an individual employment rate

derivedCompositeNaming.fixedDisclosureSentence: O numerador e o denominador descrevem lentes territoriais diferentes; esta medida é apenas contexto ecológico, não taxa, cobertura nem vínculo entre as mesmas pessoas.
derivedCompositeNaming.dependencyRule: No terminal state depends on a dual-lens composite alone; P2 additionally requires exact component closure and P4 requires the separately observed education outcome, small-sample robustness and its fixed ceiling.

executionContract.failurePolicy: fail closed with non-zero exit before any result artifact on mismatch, unknown enum, missing input, gate failure or unregistered preregistration
executionContract.runtimePin: data_pipeline/pyproject.toml plus data_pipeline/uv.lock; exact Python, numpy and pandas versions recorded in the manifest
executionContract.postFreezeAmendmentPolicy: After first raw_value access, the preregistration cannot be amended. Any unavoidable analytical-definition change voids the affected question to NOT_SUPPORTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE in a new explicitly POST_RESULT_ADJUSTMENT version; it cannot retain confirmatory language.
executionContract.failureMapping: An anticipated question-level validation failure is materialized in all required outputs as INSUFFICIENT_DATA or NOT_SUPPORTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE with reason. An unexpected runtime or integrity exception aborts the entire transactional package with non-zero exit and publishes no partial AA2 package; it is never converted to a successful empty artifact.

questions.publicQuestion: A trajetória recente do Ensino Médio de Nova Santa Rita ficou dentro do observado em municípios gaúchos com contexto semelhante?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: Demografia, escala da oferta, condição docente e ponto de partida educacional compõem o contexto no qual a trajetória é observada, sem provar que qualquer fator causou o resultado.
questions.population: 497 municípios do RS com casos completos; Nova Santa Rita obrigatória
questions.mainMethod: deterministic five-fold municipality-held-out OLS prediction; folds from SHA-256 of textual IBGE code; all features fixed before results
questions.effect: observed minus held-out predicted dropout rate in percentage points
questions.interval: 95% out-of-fold absolute-residual conformal band calibrated without Nova Santa Rita residual
alternatives: ten-fold held-out prediction with the same feature set
five-fold baseline-only model excluding contemporaneous teacher adequacy
questions.validityCriteria: at least 450 municipalities, Nova Santa Rita complete, full-rank training matrices in every fold and finite held-out predictions
questions.calibrationPass: empirical held-out 95% interval coverage from 0.92 through 0.98 inclusive and full-model RMSE no more than 1.05 times baseline-only RMSE
questions.NovaSantaRitaInterpretationRule: ABOVE_CONTEXT only if its effect is above the upper conformal bound and positive in all three prediction fits; BELOW_CONTEXT only if below the lower bound and negative in all three; otherwise WITHIN_OR_INCONCLUSIVE_CONTEXT
questions.heterogeneity: held-out residual distribution for RS, Vale and Nova Santa Rita on the identical percentage-point scale
questions.pValueReason: prediction comparison is evaluated by held-out error and calibrated interval, not a selected coefficient test

questions.publicQuestion: Quanto da mudança das matrículas do Ensino Médio acompanha a mudança da população de 15 a 17 anos e quanto aparece na relação entre população residente e oferta escolar localizada?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: A matrícula localizada pode mudar porque o grupo etário residente muda e/ou porque muda a relação territorial entre população residente e oferta escolar, sem que essa relação seja interpretada como cobertura ou frequência individual.
questions.population: 497 municípios, Vale agregado por soma de componentes e Nova Santa Rita
questions.mainMethod: exact symmetric Shapley decomposition of M=P*R, with M enrollment, P resident population and R=M/P
questions.effect: absolute enrollment change split into population component and territorial-relation component; components close exactly to total change
questions.interval: deterministic identity: lower and upper equal each exact component; no sampling interpretation
questions.closureArithmetic: float64 symmetric Shapley decomposition checked with relative tolerance abs(residual) <= 1e-9 * max(1, abs(total_enrollment_change)); realised raw residual and tolerance are serialized
questions.heterogeneity: same components for RS, Vale, Nova Santa Rita and all municipalities; no ranking
questions.pValueReason: accounting identity has no sampling null hypothesis
terminalRuleOrdered: 1 NOT_SUPPORTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE if any required endpoint or positive population denominator is absent for the requested scope
2 NOT_SUPPORTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE if closureArithmetic relative tolerance fails

questions.publicQuestion: Mudanças na adequação da formação docente caminham junto com mudanças de abandono e reprovação no Ensino Médio?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: Maior adequação entre formação docente e componente curricular pode favorecer condições pedagógicas associadas à permanência, mas composição discente, gestão e fatores territoriais alternativos permanecem explicações concorrentes.
questions.population: painel 2018-2025 dos 497 municípios do RS, etapa medio, rede total
questions.mainMethod: municipality and year fixed effects with standard errors clustered by municipality
questions.effect: percentage-point change in dropout associated with a 10 percentage-point within-municipality change in teacher adequacy
alternatives: same model with failure_rate_percent as outcome
one-year lag of teacher adequacy for dropout
questions.validityCriteria: each required fit must retain at least 450 municipalities and at least six years except WINDOW_2022_2025, which requires four years; full rank, convergence and within-exposure variance above 1e-12 are mandatory
questions.standardizedEffect: raw coefficient multiplied by the within-transformed exposure standard deviation and divided by the within-transformed outcome standard deviation
questions.heterogeneity: same observed measures for RS, Vale and Nova Santa Rita; model is statewide and no Vale coefficient is presented as statewide
questions.substantiveEffectThreshold: absolute main effect at least 0.20 percentage point of dropout per 10 percentage points of teacher adequacy
questions.robustAssociationRule: P3_MAIN_DROPOUT_L0 meets substantiveEffectThreshold, has BH-adjusted p<=0.05 and a 95% interval excluding zero; all three named direction sensitivities P3_SENS_EXCLUDE_2020_2021, P3_SENS_WINDOW_2022_2025 and P3_SENS_EXCLUDE_VALE_10 have the same coefficient sign as the main fit; absolute standardized effect of P3_PLACEBO_LEAD1 is strictly smaller than the main absolute standardized effect
terminalRuleOrdered: 1 INSUFFICIENT_DATA if any of the seven required fits fails validityCriteria

questions.publicQuestion: A intensidade do trabalho formal de jovens de 15 a 17 anos no território se move junto com o abandono no Ensino Médio?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: Oportunidades e exigências do trabalho formal podem competir com tempo escolar ou reforçar expectativas de trajetória, enquanto local de trabalho, residência e escola não identificam as mesmas pessoas.
questions.population: painel 2019-2025 dos dez municípios do Vale; dez clusters municipais

exposure.lensWarning: workplace stock divided by resident context is an ecological territorial intensity, not an employment rate
exposure.denominatorRule: resident population must be strictly positive; zero or absent denominator produces unavailable, never zero

questions.mainMethod: municipality and year fixed effects; for VALE_10 only, primary two-sided p-values from exhaustive enumeration of all 2^G Rademacher cluster sign vectors under the null, clustered by municipality and sorted by textual IBGE code; G must be 9 or 10, otherwise the fit is INSUFFICIENT_DATA and no sampled fallback is allowed
questions.effect: percentage-point dropout difference associated with one additional active formal bond per 100 residents aged 15-17
questions.interval: 95% cluster-robust interval labeled approximate for ten clusters; wild-bootstrap p-value is primary and the interval is not used alone as small-sample proof
questions.validityCriteria: each p-value fit must retain at least nine municipalities and five years, converge, be full-rank and have within-exposure variance above 1e-12; all ten leave-one-out fits must be attempted and at least nine must be valid
questions.heterogeneity: identical outcome descriptors for RS, Vale and Nova Santa Rita; the joint work-education coefficient is unavailable for RS by coverage contract
questions.resamplingGrid: For realised G in {9,10}, enumerate exactly 2^G vectors. Test statistic is the absolute studentized cluster-robust t for the exposure coefficient; k counts sign vectors whose absolute t is at least the observed absolute t. Raw two-sided p=k/2^G including the observed sign vector, minimum 1/2^G; G, denominator, k and floor are serialized.
questions.substantiveEffectThreshold: absolute main effect at least 0.10 percentage point of dropout per additional workplace bond per 100 resident-age-group context
questions.planningSignalRule: P4_MAIN_L0 meets substantiveEffectThreshold, has BH-adjusted wild-bootstrap p<=0.10 and an approximate 95% interval excluding zero; at least two of P4_ALT_L1, P4_ALT_L2 and P4_SENS_EXCLUDE_2020_2021 preserve the main sign; at least eight of ten leave-one-out coefficients preserve the main sign; absolute standardized effect of P4_PLACEBO_LEAD1 is smaller than the main effect. P4_REVERSE_DIRECTION is always reported as simultaneity diagnostic and does not select the state.
questions.mandatoryLowPowerCaveat: With ten municipalities, non-rejection cannot distinguish absence of association from insufficient power and must not be narrated as evidence of no relationship.

questions.publicQuestion: Que parcela da estrutura ocupacional formal está ligada, por correspondência normativa, aos cursos técnicos observados no município e no Vale?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: A oferta técnica pode dialogar com famílias ocupacionais do território, mas uma ponte normativa curso-CBO não mede empregabilidade, demanda futura, suficiência nem adequação da oferta.
questions.population: dez municípios do Vale, ocupações RAIS 2025 e oferta EPT 2025
questions.bridgeJoinAndDeduplication: municipality identity joins only by textual municipality_ibge_code; offer units deduplicate on municipality_ibge_code, school_code and course_code before enrollment coverage; normative links deduplicate on municipality_ibge_code, course_code and occupation_subgroup_code; six-digit occupation dimension_id maps to the declared two-digit subgroup by its first two characters, never by label
questions.mainMethod: deduplicated normative course-to-two-digit-CBO-subgroup bridge applied to local all-age active bonds
questions.effect: share of local active bonds in occupation subgroups connected to at least one locally observed technical course
questions.interval: transparent correspondence bounds: local-offer share as lower scenario and Vale-access share as upper scenario; not a statistical confidence interval
alternatives: exclude bridge rows without mapped CBO subgroup
questions.coverageFloor: Vale mapped technical enrollment share must be at least 0.70; below this threshold facts remain materialized but the question terminates NOT_SUPPORTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE
questions.heterogeneity: same correspondence share for each Vale municipality and Nova Santa Rita; RS explicitly unavailable because detailed EPT and occupation coverage is VALE_10
questions.pValueReason: normative correspondence accounting is descriptive and has no sampling null
terminalRuleOrdered: 1 NOT_SUPPORTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE if the bridge hash mismatches, the occupation denominator is non-positive or coverageFloor fails

questions.publicQuestion: A escolaridade adulta do território se relaciona com a distribuição da EJA e com o perfil escolar dos vínculos formais jovens?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: Déficits acumulados de escolarização podem aparecer simultaneamente na escolaridade adulta, na oferta localizada de EJA e no perfil escolar do trabalho jovem, sem identificar demanda individual ou trajetória da mesma pessoa.
questions.population: snapshot 2022 dos dez municípios do Vale

outcomes.denominatorRule: strictly positive; zero or absent denominator produces unavailable, never zero

questions.mainMethod: Spearman rank correlation with B=99,999 deterministic PCG64 permutations as the primary two-sided small-sample inference for each preregistered outcome; statistic is absolute rho, k counts permuted absolute statistics at least the observed absolute statistic, and p=(k+1)/(B+1), floor 0.00001; fit-specific seeds follow sharedRules.randomGenerator
questions.interval: 95% municipality bootstrap percentile interval with 10,000 deterministic resamples
alternatives: Pearson correlation with the same permutation procedure for both outcomes
questions.validityCriteria: each relationship must retain at least eight municipalities and at least four distinct ranks in both variables; all twenty leave-one-out fits are attempted and at least sixteen are valid; unknown schooling is preserved and never redistributed
questions.heterogeneity: same adult-completion measure for RS, Vale and Nova Santa Rita; joint EJA/work relations are unavailable for RS
questions.stablePatternRule: at least one primary Spearman fit meets substantiveEffectThreshold, has BH-adjusted permutation p<=0.10, its descriptive bootstrap interval excludes zero and at least eight of ten leave-one-out coefficients for that outcome preserve its sign
questions.discordanceRule: A permutation rejection with a descriptive bootstrap interval containing zero is deterministically classified NO_ROBUST_ASSOCIATION and narrated as 'permutation evidence was not stable under municipal resampling'; the p-value never overrides the interval.
questions.mandatoryLowPowerCaveat: With at most ten municipalities, failure to meet stablePatternRule cannot distinguish absence of relationship from insufficient power; bootstrap intervals are descriptive and permutation p-values are primary.
terminalRuleOrdered: 1 INSUFFICIENT_DATA if validityCriteria fails for either primary relationship

questions.publicQuestion: A oferta escolar rural e a oferta de AEE acompanham as mudanças de matrículas que deveriam orientar o acesso?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: Escolas e serviços especializados estruturam possibilidades de acesso, mas contagens de matrículas e unidades podem crescer juntas por escala, registro, política de inclusão ou reorganização da rede e não medem suficiência.
questions.population: painel 2014-2025 dos dez municípios do Vale
questions.mainMethod: separate municipality and year fixed-effects models for rural and AEE components; for VALE_10 only, primary two-sided p-values from exhaustive enumeration of all 2^G Rademacher cluster sign vectors under the null, sorted by textual IBGE code; G must be 9 or 10, otherwise the fit is INSUFFICIENT_DATA and no sampled fallback is allowed
questions.effect: within-municipality elasticity of enrollments to observed school/service count
questions.interval: 95% cluster-robust interval labeled approximate for ten clusters; wild-bootstrap p-values are primary
questions.validityCriteria: each required fit must retain at least nine municipalities and eight years, converge, be full-rank and have within-exposure variance above 1e-12; all twenty leave-one-out fits are attempted and at least eighteen are valid; suppressed or unavailable values never enter log1p
questions.heterogeneity: identical descriptive measures for Vale and Nova Santa Rita; RS relationship explicitly unavailable by coverage
questions.resamplingGrid: For realised G in {9,10}, enumerate exactly 2^G vectors. Test statistic is the absolute studentized cluster-robust t for the exposure coefficient; k counts sign vectors whose absolute t is at least the observed absolute t. Raw two-sided p=k/2^G including the observed sign vector, minimum 1/2^G; G, denominator, k and floor are serialized.
questions.stableComponentRule: for at least one component, the main fit meets substantiveEffectThreshold, has BH-adjusted wild-bootstrap p<=0.10 and an approximate 95% interval excluding zero, both its exclude-2020-2021 and lag-1 fits preserve sign, and at least eight of ten leave-one-out coefficients preserve sign
questions.mandatoryLowPowerCaveat: With ten municipalities, non-rejection cannot distinguish absence of association from insufficient power; school/service counts do not measure access sufficiency.
terminalRuleOrdered: 1 INSUFFICIENT_DATA if validityCriteria fails for both components
2 PLANNING_SIGNAL_ONLY if stableComponentRule passes for at least one component

questions.publicQuestion: A capacidade financeira aplicada à educação se associa à intensidade da oferta de tempo integral, depois de considerar a escala da rede?
questions.mechanismHypothesis: Maior capacidade de aplicação pode viabilizar oferta, mas gasto e oferta são decididos conjuntamente, refletem necessidades diferentes e não permitem inferir efeito causal.
questions.population: cross-section 2025 dos municípios do RS com casos completos
questions.mainMethod: cross-sectional OLS with HC3 errors: full-time share on log MDE applied amount and log total enrollments
questions.effect: percentage-point full-time-share difference associated with 10% higher MDE applied amount at the same enrollment scale, calculated exactly as the log-exposure coefficient multiplied by ln(1.1)
alternatives: 2025 log MDE per enrollment without the size control
questions.validityCriteria: all four fits must retain at least 400 municipalities, be full-rank and have non-degenerate outcome and exposure; Nova Santa Rita must be complete for its residual diagnostic
questions.financePriceBasis: nominal BRL within each reference year; 2024 and 2025 coefficients are separate repetitions and no nominal amount is compared across years
questions.heterogeneity: same full-time share and finance-per-enrollment descriptors for RS, Vale and Nova Santa Rita; regression remains statewide
questions.substantiveEffectThreshold: absolute main effect at least 0.10 percentage point in full-time share per 10% higher MDE applied amount
questions.contextComparisonRule: P8_MAIN_2025_SIZE_ADJUSTED meets substantiveEffectThreshold, has BH-adjusted p<=0.05 and a 95% HC3 interval excluding zero; at least two of the three named coefficient fits P8_ALT_2024_SIZE_ADJUSTED, P8_ALT_2025_PER_ENROLLMENT and P8_SENS_2025_TRIMMED_1_PERCENT preserve the main sign
questions.mandatoryEndogeneityCaveat: Finance and offer are jointly determined; the comparison is cross-sectional, size-adjusted and non-causal, with reverse causation and omitted need/capacity factors remaining plausible.
